digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and subprocess runtime handling
propositions: Write/apply and subprocess paths rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of scoped S2 runtimes, creating credential isolation and scope leakage risks
Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in four locations: write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default that can trigger unintended scope writes
Child processes inherit ambient parent environment and adapter secrets without filtering, exposing unrelated sibling adapters' credentials and native variables

Environment projection and child-environment builder must separate trusted same-capability children (ambient inheritance), owning children (adapter overlay), and unrelated siblings (exact secret names removed) without mutating global os.environ
All four implicit DIG defaults must be eliminated so unset project scope fails closed with typed error instead of defaulting to DIG
